answer: Proof of space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit dedicated disk sectors to verifiable cryptographic tables. Periodic audits anchor each identity to physical storage, forcing attackers to incur the capital cost of purchasing hard drives per node. Stored records remain as static as carved marble, proven through lookup paths that branch like a lotus leaf. A key limitation is that attackers with idle data center storage can register fake agents with minimal marginal expenditure.
